name: Horsenden Hill Community Orchard
description: One of London's finest community orchards with around 50 fruit trees including plums, cherries, apples, and espalier pears. Hosts an annual Apple Day in autumn.

name: Brent River Park Wild Blackberries
short_description: Brambles along the Brent river path.
description: Brambles line the riverside path of Brent River Park between Hanwell and Greenford, yielding a generous blackberry harvest in late summer.
